title: Bioinspired photonic materials for advanced thermal management
content:

Kan Yao, Gaoyang Kong, Chengyu Xiao, Shaowen Chen, Yifan Zhang, Xing Lou, Jing Li, Di Zhang, Han Zhou, Yuebing Zheng
Maintenance of suitable temperature is essential for human activity, and thermal management is the science devoted to this goal. This review presents the recent advances in biomimetic photonic materials and strategies for thermal management.
